TransactionStatus.description_en:
The transaction status. Valid values:

Transaction Commit: The transaction has been committed.

Transaction Rollback: The transaction has been rolled back
TransactionStatus.description_zh:
事务状态。各取值含义如下：

Transaction Commit：事务已提交。

Transaction Rollback：事务已回滚

description_en: Commits transaction changes by calling the CommitTransaction operation
description_zh: 调用CommitTransaction接口提交事务变更
name: CommitTransaction

parameters.help_en: The user credential of the Data API account. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter. Format: `acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`
parameters.help_zh: Data API账号的用户凭证，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取该参数的值。格式如下：0
parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) that specifies the resource to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

regionId: the region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
accountId: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html operation to obtain this value.
instanceId: the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

regionId：地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html接口获取。
instanceId：实例ID
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transaction to commit. You can call the BeginTransaction operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 需要提交的事务ID，您可调用BeginTransaction接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: transaction_id
